propositions: Cloud (accountId) and Data Center (name) user identity representations require a contract-bound abstraction to prevent assignee-diff churn from non-authoritative resolution.
PR #120's implementation returns authoritative=False unconditionally for DC assignees, causing re-emission of unconvergent assignee changes.

UserIdentityModel protocol with resolve(local_value, remote_identity) and to_payload(value) methods must be implemented separately for Cloud and DC, with DC performing actual user-search lookup rather than echoing local values.

NameIdentity (DC) must return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees to break the diff-churn cycle; AccountIdIdentity (Cloud) preserves existing 3-state behavior with getattr collaborator at backend.py:122.
Unresolvable assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning non-authoritative values.
Identity models receive resolvers as explicit constructor parameters, eliminating the unreachable getattr-discovered branch pattern from PR #120.
